title_zh: NEWS IN 10 每日新聞英語｜11 月 17 日

stories.headline_en: Taiwan Ranks 13th in Global Digital and AI Competitiveness Report
stories.headline_zh: 臺灣於 2026 全球數位與 AI 競爭力報告名列第 13 名

sentences.en: Taiwan ranked thirteenth among seventy economies in a new global digital and AI report.
sentences.zh: 臺灣在一項新的全球數位與人工智慧報告中，於七十個經濟體裡名列第十三名。

sentences.en: Local companies scored very high for investing in worker AI training programs.
sentences.zh: 臺灣企業在投資員工人工智慧培訓計畫方面獲得了極高評價。

sentences.en: Businesses in Taiwan also showed strong awareness of online safety risks.
sentences.zh: 臺灣企業對網路安全風險也展現出高度的警覺意識。

sentences.en: The digital ministry plans to use more AI tools to improve public services.
sentences.zh: 數位發展部計畫運用更多人工智慧工具來提升公共服務品質。

stories.headline_en: OpenAI and UK Charity Launch Free AI Skills Training for Youth
stories.headline_zh: OpenAI 攜手英國慈善機構推動青年免費 AI 技能培訓

sentences.en: OpenAI and a British charity launched a new program to help young people.
sentences.zh: OpenAI 與一家英國慈善機構共同推出一項協助年輕人的新計畫。

sentences.en: They will offer free training in practical AI skills over eighteen months.
sentences.zh: 他們將在十八個月內提供免費的實用人工智慧技能培訓。

sentences.en: The program aims to support twenty-five thousand youth aged sixteen to thirty.
sentences.zh: 這項計畫旨在支持兩萬五千名十六至三十歲的青年。

sentences.en: Students can earn useful qualifications and build confidence for future office jobs.
sentences.zh: 學員可以取得實用資格認證，並為未來的職場工作建立信心。

stories.headline_en: IMF Chief Warns Global Economy Relies Too Heavily on AI Spending
stories.headline_zh: IMF 總裁示警全球經濟過度依賴 AI 投資與融資

sentences.en: A top global finance leader warned that the world economy relies too much on AI.
sentences.zh: 一位全球頂尖財經領袖警告，世界經濟過度依賴人工智慧產業。

sentences.en: She explained that heavy spending on technology is currently driving most economic growth.
sentences.zh: 她指出，目前龐大的科技支出正帶動大部分的經濟成長。

sentences.en: However, rising stock values could drop sharply if company profits fail to meet expectations.
sentences.zh: 然而，若企業獲利未能達到預期，高漲的股市市值可能會大幅滑落。

sentences.en: Experts advise investors to stay careful because market losses can spread across countries.
sentences.zh: 專家建議投資人保持謹慎，因為市場虧損可能會跨國蔓延。
